name: laravel-react-boilerplate
description: Unified full-stack boilerplate combining Laravel 12 Clean Architecture Backend and React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 7 + Tailwind CSS v4 Frontend

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -c "#38bdf8,#818cf8" "npm run dev:be" "npm run dev:fe" --names="Laravel-API,React-Vite" --kill-others
scripts.setup: npm run setup:be && npm run setup:fe
scripts.setup:be: cd backend && composer install && php -r "file_exists('.env') || copy('.env.example', '.env');" && php artisan key:generate && touch database/database.sqlite && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
